dimensions.label: Replication
dimensions.detail: single run — no replication across seeds declared (add robustness.seeds or simulation_set.seeds)

dimensions.label: Controls & calibration
dimensions.detail: no controls — declare a system that SHOULD fail the criteria (externally-maintained / -supplied) plus a clearly-passing / borderline case so the metric is calibrated, not just asserted

dimensions.label: Alternative hypotheses
dimensions.detail: interpretation-tier finding(s) present but no competing explanations considered (add alternative_hypotheses + how the evidence discriminates)

dimensions.label: Claim discipline
dimensions.detail: findings tiered; interpretation claims carry evidence

dimensions.label: Falsifiability
dimensions.detail: criteria read as tailored-to-succeed — add a falsifiability note (study.falsifiability)

dimensions.label: Engineered vs emergent
dimensions.detail: 1 interpretation claim(s) don't state whether the mechanism is engineered or emergent

dimensions.label: Limitations stated
dimensions.detail: no limitations / 'what this does not show' — add a short bound on the claim (scope/fidelity of the model, what is NOT demonstrated)

dimensions.label: Next steps
dimensions.detail: no discovery_implications or follow_up_studies — state what this study changes and what to investigate next (the Decide phase)

dimensions.label: Threshold provenance
dimensions.detail: all 2 numeric band(s) carry a source (cites or pass_if.provenance.kind)

dimensions.label: Metric calibration ladder
dimensions.detail: no calibration_ladder declared — index controls[] by known_fail / known_pass / borderline / stress rungs so the metric is calibrated across its range, not just asserted

dimensions.label: Run persistence
dimensions.detail: 2 run(s) recorded but none carry an emitter (sqlite/parquet/xarray) or a run-db reference — the trajectories are not persisted; runs should emit via the workspace emitter
